whyKasa.title: A branded LMS built for institutes that want ownership, speed, and control.
whyKasa.description: KASA helps education businesses avoid scattered plugins, marketplace dependency, and long custom LMS builds by bringing sales, learning, payments, live classes, CRM, and reports into one platform.
whyKasa.story: Most academies do not fail because they lack content. They struggle because website, payment, class links, learner access, certificates, and follow-ups are spread across different tools. KASA gives the team one operating system for the academy.

blocks.title: Built for real academy workflows
blocks.body: KASA starts from the practical needs of coaching teams: sell programs, run classes, manage learners, collect fees, track progress, and issue certificates.

blocks.title: Launch without custom build delays
blocks.body: Configure your domain, brand, payment keys, email, media, and live class setup without waiting months for a custom LMS project.

blocks.title: Designed for owned growth
blocks.body: Your institute keeps its brand, domain, learner data, pricing, course catalog, and sales journey instead of sending everything to a third-party marketplace.

blocks.title: One system for the whole team
blocks.body: Admin, sales, faculty, and learners work from connected dashboards, so every order, class, certificate, and lead has context.

about.title: We build the software layer for modern coaching and academy businesses.
about.description: KASA is focused on one clear idea: education teams should be able to launch, sell, teach, track, and scale from their own branded platform without stitching together ten tools.
about.storyTitle: A platform for teams that want to own the academy experience
about.story: From the first course page to the final certificate, KASA is designed so learners stay inside your academy brand and your team gets operational clarity. The product brings website, learning, commerce, live classes, CRM, and reporting into one practical workflow.

blocks.title: Product philosophy
blocks.body: KASA avoids bloated enterprise complexity while still covering the workflows serious institutes need every day.

blocks.title: Technology foundation
blocks.body: The platform is built around a modern Next.js client, NestJS backend, PostgreSQL database, Docker services, and AWS infrastructure.

blocks.title: Education workflows
blocks.body: Course selling, live batches, self-paced learning, assignments, certificates, payment records, and CRM are treated as one connected system.

blocks.title: Customer fit
blocks.body: KASA is made for coaching institutes, online academies, trainers, skill centres, and EdTech teams that need an owned LMS.

contact.title: Talk to KASA about your academy, courses, batches, and rollout plan.
contact.description: Share what you want to launch or improve. The KASA team can help map the right setup for course selling, live classes, payments, learner dashboards, certificates, CRM, and admin reporting.
contact.storyTitle: A better conversation starts with your workflow
contact.story: Instead of a generic demo, KASA conversations focus on your academy structure: course models, live batch needs, payment flow, faculty roles, learner access, and growth plans.

blocks.title: For new academies
blocks.body: Plan your domain, website, course catalog, payment gateway, email, media, and launch sequence from the start.

blocks.title: For running institutes
blocks.body: Move scattered workflows into one branded LMS without losing your current academic and sales process.

blocks.title: For EdTech teams
blocks.body: Use KASA as a software foundation for branded learning products, live programs, and scalable operations.

blocks.title: For product tours
blocks.body: Use the compact Product Tour form to share your requirements. The KASA team will contact you shortly and schedule a guided demo.

plans.name: Launch
